name: Reading practice
description: A long, original mission briefing for testing controller, keyboard and touch reading in the practice game.

metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Local practice fixture; no third-party art or media.

classRecipes.label: Scout
classRecipes.description: Mark hidden objectives permanently; show enemy direction hints for four seconds. No slowing.

classRecipes.label: Light carrier
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge at a supply pad; drop a field that stuns nearby field enemies.

classRecipes.label: Heavy carrier
classRecipes.description: Carry two charges; each creates the same temporary stun field.

classRecipes.label: Interceptor
classRecipes.description: Absorb one enemy or lane contact: cancel the cut and recover at spawn without losing a life. Self-crossing remains dangerous.

classRecipes.label: Fiber relay
classRecipes.description: Ignore signal interference and scan for hidden relays. Your cable is the live trail: enemy contact still breaks it.

classRecipes.label: Impact craft
classRecipes.description: Release a close-range stun pulse, abandon the unfinished cut and redeploy at home without losing a life. The pulse never captures territory.

classRecipes.label: Trapper
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge and place a four-second field that slows field enemies to one quarter speed.

metadata.title: The patient route
metadata.description:
A quiet place to read

This practice flight uses the familiar first map. There is no mission deadline, no required relay, and no hidden equipment condition. Reveal 45 percent by closing a line on safe ground. You can read this whole briefing before starting. Reading never earns a score or a picture, and leaving the reader never launches the craft.

Find the safe ground

The border is your starting shelter. The small craft begins halfway across its top edge. The moving field enemy stays in the dark interior. Leave the border to draw a live line, then reach safe ground again. The game reveals regions that contain no field enemy. If the enemy reaches you or your open line, that attempt costs a life. Earlier captured ground remains.

Choose a comfortable input

Both Immediate and Grid + buffer steering are available. Immediate turning changes direction at the current position. Grid + buffer waits for the next cell center. The lab can send the same physical button positions and stick axes as a standard controller. Joining takes a deliberate face-button press. Release before confirming another action. These controls are a software practice surface; they cannot measure the comfort of a real controller in your hands.

Take your time with the text

Select Read mission brief to enter the reader. Use the configured menu directions to scroll up or down. Keep scrolling until you reach the last paragraph. Left and right do not move you sideways through a line of text. Use Done reading, the configured Confirm or Back, or Menu to return. A separate gesture is needed to choose Start or Resume afterward. Keyboard and touch can still scroll this text naturally.

Learn one line at a time

The picture is a Ukrainian-inspired garden made from simple original shapes and colors. Walls, objectives, enemies, and your live trail are independent game objects, so a different painting or theme can reuse the same rules. This practice map does not add new abilities or alter the field enemy. You can choose a different starting class to compare its presentation and available equipment.

Pause, return, try again

Pause before changing your setup. Losing focus or disconnecting the virtual pad releases its held buttons and stick directions. Reconnect deliberately when you are ready. The controller reader also leaves its active state when focus moves elsewhere. This helps separate reading from flying. A fresh attempt resets the board; the controller lab grants no campaign rewards even after a win.

End of briefing

You have reached the last paragraph. Return with Done reading or your configured Back control, then choose Start mission when you want to fly. The first straightforward route is down from the marked start to the opposite border. Watch the live line, enjoy the picture, and take another route whenever you feel ready.
